label: Leo X

claims.statement: Giovanni de' Medici, son of Lorenzo and brother of Giuliano de' Medici, Leonardo's patron in Rome. The Belvedere years fall in his reign, which ran beyond the end of the chart.

claims.statement: Vasari reports that Leo X, hearing Leonardo was distilling oils for varnish before starting a work, said 'Oimè, costui non è per far nulla'. This is what Vasari states; no document confirms it.

value.text: Leonardo in Rome under his brother Giuliano, 1513 to 1516

claims.statement: Leonardo's Roman years fall in his reign; his patron was the pope's brother Giuliano. No direct papal commission is documented.

open_questions: The draft uses 11 March 1513 as the start. Is the election itself 9 or 11 March? Election, proclamation (11 March) and coronation (19 March) should be separate dated claims; the chart could start at 11 March (proclamation) with a note.
